'''Yram''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who ruled as [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. An obelisk named [[Queen Yram's Needle/Legends|Queen Yram's Needle]] was located in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] Yram was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', a [[2000]] reference book by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
